correct_pct.label: Correct scenarios
correct_pct.description: Every achievable intent fulfilled exactly once, nothing unintended live.

completion_pct.label: Legitimate completion
completion_pct.description: Achievable intents with their intended effect at the horizon.

unsafe_scenarios.label: Unsafe scenarios
unsafe_scenarios.description: Scenarios ending with any duplicate or unintended live money movement.

duplicate_effects.label: Duplicate effects
duplicate_effects.description: Extra live effects for an intent beyond the first.

unintended_effects.label: Unintended effects
unintended_effects.description: Live effects matching no achievable intent (wrong order/amount/customer...).

wrong_money_minor.label: Wrong money moved
wrong_money_minor.description: Amount of duplicate + unintended effects still live at the horizon.

undetected_wrong_minor.label: Undetected wrong money
undetected_wrong_minor.description: Wrong money in scenarios where the system raised no flag.

recovered_effects.label: Reversed effects
recovered_effects.description: Transactions that were created and then cancelled/voided.

misreports.label: Misreported outcomes
misreports.description: System claims success with no intended effect, or failure while one exists.

false_blocks.label: False blocks
false_blocks.description: Achievable intents left unfulfilled after a correct proposal was rejected.

unresolved_intents.label: Unresolved at horizon
unresolved_intents.description: Intents the system still reports as in progress at the horizon.

review_cases.label: Human reviews
review_cases.description: Cases escalated to a human (cost of safety).

latency_mean_ms.label: Mean submit latency
latency_mean_ms.description: Wall-clock time per agent submission, in-process provider.

latency_p95_ms.label: p95 submit latency
latency_p95_ms.description: 95th percentile wall-clock time per agent submission.
